message.content:
1) **3D AI Analyst:** The character is clearly visible and looks professional. It has a sleek, futuristic design with a glowing blue visor and stands on an illuminated platform, fitting the "virtual risk analyst" theme perfectly.

2) **Typography & Hierarchy:** The design is highly polished. The typography uses strong weight and size contrasts (large headings, clear body text). Spacing is generous and consistent, creating a clean, uncluttered layout with excellent visual hierarchy.

3) **Visual Defects:** There are no visual defects. All text is legible without overlapping, elements are perfectly aligned, nothing appears broken, and there are no blank regions. The overall execution is top-tier.
